data.title: Decision: electric wheelchair application rejected, scooter with push aid granted instead
data.summary: Beispielkasse Ersatzkrankenkasse (statutory health insurer, Hilfsmittelteam) informs Bastian Musterquell on 20 November 2026 that it will not provide an electric wheelchair, since the Medical Service (Medizinischer Dienst) found he can manage short indoor distances with a rollator; instead it approves a wheelchair with a push aid (Schiebehilfe) for his companion for longer distances.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has turned down the electric wheelchair you applied for, based on the medical assessment, and approved a push-aid wheelchair instead. If you disagree, you have the right to file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the insurer's office; the app shows until when you can still do this. If you do nothing by then, the decision becomes final and only the approved wheelchair with push aid will be provided. You may want to discuss the medical assessment with your doctor or a patient advice service before deciding.
